import math
s=lambda d: math.sin(math.radians(d))**2
v=s(30)-s(40)+s(45)-s(55)-s(35)+s(45)-s(50)+s(60)
opts={'A':4,'B':0,'C':1,'D':2}
assert abs(v-opts['B'])<1e-12
for k,o in opts.items():
    if k!='B': assert abs(v-o)>1e-6

import sympy as sp
k=sp.symbols('k')
sol=set(sp.solve(sp.Eq(sp.Rational(88,8)*k-9, 36-35+k**2),k))
opts={'A':{2,7},'B':{4,7},'C':{3,10},'D':{1,10}}
assert sol==opts['D']
for kk,v in opts.items():
    if kk!='D': assert sol!=v
